metadata.title: Why One Electron at a Time Still Builds Stripes
metadata.thing: a detector screen that fills with dots into interference fringes
metadata.color_notes: Interference fringes / wave = accent Warm Slate #5A5653. Dots and apparatus = ink #1a1a1a. Red #C0392B reserved for emphasis if needed.

beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Fire electrons at a screen one at a time, so alone that only one is ever in flight.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Fire electrons at a screen one at a time, so alone that only one is ever in flight.
beats.new_visual_element: a person at an electron gun firing a single electron
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person standing beside an electron gun apparatus]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person firing one small electron dot toward the right]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person and gun draw themselves in stroke by stroke, one small electron shoots right; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Each should land as a single dot — a particle, with nothing to interfere with.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Each should land as a single dot — a particle, with nothing to interfere with.
beats.new_visual_element: the person watching a single dot appear on a screen
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person looking at a screen with one small dot on it]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person shrugging at the single dot on the screen]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person and screen draw themselves in, one dot appears; person shrugs; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Set up two narrow slits with a detector screen waiting behind them.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Set up two narrow slits with a detector screen waiting behind them.
beats.new_visual_element: a barrier with two slits on the left, a tall detector screen on the right
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a vertical barrier with two gaps (slits) at left and a tall detector screen line at right, stroke-on, ink

beats.narration_text: The first electrons strike the screen as scattered, random dots.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The first electrons strike the screen as scattered, random dots.
beats.new_visual_element: a handful of random dots appearing on the screen
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a few dots pop onto the screen at random heights, one by one; slits/screen locked

beats.narration_text: After a hundred, the dots still look like meaningless speckle.
beats.tts_normalized_text: After a hundred, the dots still look like meaningless speckle.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: rapidly add dots to ~100 total, still visually random; counter '100'

beats.narration_text: But after seventy thousand, the dots stack into sharp bright and dark stripes.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But after seventy thousand, the dots stack into sharp bright and dark stripes.
beats.new_visual_element: thousands of dots resolve into vertical interference fringes
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: flood dots sampled from an interference probability so clear vertical fringe bands emerge; counter '70,000'

beats.narration_text: Those stripes are an interference pattern — the signature of overlapping waves.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Those stripes are an interference pattern — the signature of overlapping waves.
beats.new_visual_element: a Warm-Slate intensity curve traced over the fringe bands
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: overlay a smooth accent-color interference intensity curve aligned to the bands; dots locked

beats.narration_text: Each electron's wave passed through both slits at once and interfered with itself.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Each electron's wave passed through both slits at once and interfered with itself.
beats.new_visual_element: one incoming wave splitting through both slits into two ripple fronts that overlap
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: redraw slits; a single wavefront hits, emerges as two circular ripple sets from the slits, overlapping into an interference field

beats.narration_text: That self-interference sets the odds of where its single dot can land.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That self-interference sets the odds of where its single dot can land.
beats.new_visual_element: a probability envelope along the screen, peaks where ripples reinforce
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: trace an accent probability curve on the screen, peaks aligned to constructive overlap, zeros at cancellation

beats.narration_text: Any one dot is random; the crowd of them traces those odds exactly.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Any one dot is random; the crowd of them traces those odds exactly.
beats.new_visual_element: dots filling under the envelope until they match its shape
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: dots rain onto the screen, densest under the envelope peaks, recreating the fringe pattern beneath the curve

beats.narration_text: A particle too small to split still travels as a wave of possibility.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A particle too small to split still travels as a wave of possibility.
beats.new_visual_element: a single wave gliding in, collapsing to one dot — wave and dot together
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: show one wave travel to the screen and resolve into a single highlighted dot, with the envelope faint behind; clean close
